name: Dragon's Breath

frame.name: Composite Propellant
frame.description: Rockets embed themselves in struck targets and periodically eject incendiary fuel that inflicts Scorch. The longer this weapon goes without firing, the more fuel the next rocket contains. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.description:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: High Octane
perks.description: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: Burn the world. Burn it all.

catalyst.name: Dragon's Breath Catalyst
catalyst.description: This weapon replenishes its fuel faster. Defeating targets with this weapon causes them to periodically drop Firesprites.
